To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Ustroń lineup — request for review before Friday

Marek, I would like to request a review of the proposed lineup before the names are submitted on Friday, 13 November. I do not agree with placing Liliana in reserve on the basis of the November rating list alone.

In your post of 1 October, you stated that selection would take account of both the November FIDE list and form in club events, including the rapid qualifier, and that the players’ coaches would be consulted before the final lineup. As Liliana’s coach, I have not been consulted. I would therefore ask that this lineup remain provisional until that consultation has taken place and both announced criteria have been considered.

In the qualifier on 24 October, Liliana finished second with 5.5/7, ahead of Maja on 4.5/7 and Igor and Antoni on 4/7. She beat Maja and Antoni and drew with Kacper. Although a rapid event is not the same as the forthcoming team competition, it was explicitly included in the selection criteria and should carry meaningful weight.

The November list places Liliana at 1851 and Igor at 1874, a difference of 23 points. Liliana’s entire 81-point loss came from Katowice, where health reasons affected her performance, although she completed all her games. In my assessment, that result does not accurately reflect her current playing strength. She missed approximately two weeks of training in October for health reasons, but has now returned to her normal level; her last three lessons were very good.

This is not an objection to Igor personally or a criticism of his ability. My concern is that the announced selection process should be applied consistently.

I request that Liliana be placed on board 2. Alternatively, I would accept a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday, with the format and its implications for selection agreed in advance. Please confirm before submission how the lineup will be reviewed and the coaches consulted.
